description: Shared-rule candidates found while authoring classes.logic.json — inlined there for now (same shape as a logic_rules entry). Every one of the 33 class blocks repeats class_card_held, class_card_token_count, class_card_indestructible and the three validations; the ability gate and the EP stance repeat in subsets.

candidates.name: Class card sits in the permanents
candidates.description: Rule 9: the class ability is available only while the class card is among the caster's permanents (it always is for a living character, but creatures and class-less contexts fail it).

candidates.name: Class card — one 6-token per colour
candidates.description: The class card enters with one token of fixed value 6 (fixed_power_6) per listed colour; this is the count. Pair with fixed_power_6 for the value.

candidates.name: Class card — Rule 24 never destroys it
candidates.description: using_rule_24 with is_class_card true: whatever the die, the class card is not destroyed (Rule 9). Supersedes the classes.json note 'destroy cost = point-buy all colours at 6'.

candidates.name: Class ability gate by ability_kind
candidates.description: once_per_round: not used this round; tap: card untapped (untap by emitting each listed colour once); static: always ready.

candidates.name: Empty-action stance of the EP classes
candidates.description: peer.mjs: a Reaver's EP and EM fight as Attack, a Barbarian's EP as Block, a Monk's EP as Move; everything else is unchanged. Used by class_reaver / class_barbarian / class_monk and by action_empty_posture / action_empty_move.

candidates.name: List length within +-1 of canonical
candidates.description: Validation: |count(proposal list) − count(canonical list)| <= 1. Used for class colours; applicable to element_cost, combos and dice patterns too.

candidates.name: Heal capped at the missing life
candidates.description: min(amount, max0(life_max − life)) — Healer, Guardian, Noble lifesteal, Overlord armor.
